# Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

# Data

Run the code in the notebook `queries.md` or download the data from [google drive](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1w5dl4QCyou4eIPccrZhA4jfqr0Ejmgtw?usp=drive_link) and save it in this folder in a subfolder `data`.

```{r}
snapshot_dir <- here::here(
 "100_reporting", "20261014_analysis_sv34", "data"
)

df_loceval <- readRDS(file.path(snapshot_dir, "le_fieldwork.rds"))
df_installations <- readRDS(file.path(
  snapshot_dir, "gw_fieldwork_installations.rds"
))
df_samples <- rbind(
  readRDS(file.path(
    snapshot_dir, "gw_fieldwork_samples.rds"
  )),
  readRDS(file.path(snapshot_dir, "surf_fieldwork.rds"))
)
```

# Transformations

Function to aggregate the data. With the **group_by** argument you can set the group used to aggregate. The **date_filter** can be used to filter out dates (the date_filter is used as 'up to including').

```{r}
filter_date <- function(table, date_filter) {
  table |> filter(date_visit <= date_filter)
}

calculate_count <- function(
    df_loceval,
    df_installations,
    df_samples,
    group_by = c("scheme"), 
    date_filter = NULL
) {
  if (!is.null(date_filter)) {
    df_loceval <- df_loceval |> filter_date(date_filter)
    df_installations <- df_installations |> filter_date(date_filter)
    df_samples <- df_samples |> filter_date(date_filter)
  }
  
  df1 <- df_loceval |> 
    group_by(across(all_of(group_by))) |> 
    summarize(
      nr_locevals = n(),
      nr_samplingunits = n_distinct(sampleunit_id),
      nr_locations = n_distinct(grts_address),
      nr_approved_locevals = sum(loceval_approved),
      nr_approved_samplingunits = n_distinct(sampleunit_id[loceval_approved == TRUE]),
      nr_approved_locations = n_distinct(grts_address[loceval_approved == TRUE])
    )
  df2 <- df_installations |>
    group_by(across(all_of(group_by))) |>
    summarise(
      nr_installations = n(),
      nr_installed_samplingunits = n_distinct(sampleunit_id),
      nr_installed_locations = n_distinct(grts_address),
      nr_piezometers = n_distinct(watina_code_used_2_piezometer, na.rm = TRUE),
      nr_peilbuizen = n_distinct(watina_code_used_1_peilbuis, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  df3 <- df_samples |>
    group_by(across(all_of(group_by))) |>
    summarise(
      nr_samples = n(),
      nr_sampled_samplingunits = n_distinct(sampleunit_id),
      nr_sampled_locations = n_distinct(grts_address)
    )
  
  df1 |>
    left_join(df2, by = group_by) |>
    left_join(df3, by = group_by) |>
    arrange(across(all_of(group_by)))
}
```

# Output

```{r}
cutoff_date <- make_date(year = 2025, month = 12, day = 31)
```

```{r}
df_all <- calculate_count(
  df_loceval, df_installations, df_samples
)
df_all_2025 <- calculate_count(
  df_loceval, df_installations, df_samples, 
  date_filter = cutoff_date
)

df_grouped <- calculate_count(
  df_loceval, df_installations, df_samples, 
  group_by = c('scheme', 'domain_part')
)
df_grouped_2025 <- calculate_count(
  df_loceval, df_installations, df_samples, 
  group_by = c('scheme', 'domain_part'), 
  date_filter = cutoff_date
)
```

```{r}
#| label: write-tables-google-sheet
#| include: false

google_sheet_id <- Sys.getenv("GOOGLE_SHEET_ID")

tables_to_export <- list(
  df_all = df_all,
  df_all_2025 = df_all_2025,
  df_grouped = df_grouped,
  df_grouped_2025 = df_grouped_2025
)

prepare_table_for_google_sheets <- function(data) {
  data |>
    mutate(
      across(
        where(\(column) inherits(column, "integer64")),
        as.character
      )
    )
}

if (nzchar(google_sheet_id)) {
  googlesheets4::gs4_auth()
  iwalk(tables_to_export, \(data, sheet_name) {
    googlesheets4::sheet_write(
      data = prepare_table_for_google_sheets(data),
      ss = google_sheet_id,
      sheet = sheet_name
    )
  })
} else {
  message("Set GOOGLE_SHEET_ID to write report tables to Google Sheets.")
}
```
